title: Correct induced EMF
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the induced EMF in the coil using Faraday's law with the given slope from the graph.

title: Correct total circuit current
description: Essential: Student obtains the final current through the metal rod (2.5 A) using Ohm's law with the correct total resistance.

title: Correct Ampere force expression
description: Important: Student correctly relates the magnetic force on the rod to B₂, the current, and the length L.

title: Correct force balance setup
description: Important: Student sets up the equilibrium condition where the total magnetic force equals the total spring force (2kΔx).

title: Correct B₂ calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly solves for the magnitude of magnetic field B₂ (4 T) from the force balance equation.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall: Student fails to convert area from cm² to m² or length from cm to m, leading to incorrect numerical results.

title: Resistance combination mistake
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly calculates the total circuit resistance, e.g., omitting the coil's internal resistance or mishandling the parallel/series combination.

title: Spring force oversight
description: Pitfall: Student uses only one spring's force (kΔx) instead of the total force from both springs (2kΔx) in the balance equation.

title: Graph slope interpretation
description: Important: Student correctly identifies the rate of change of B₁ (5 T/s) from the provided linear graph pattern.

title: Unit analysis or check
description: Optional: Student includes dimensional analysis or a reasonableness check for the final answers (e.g., T is a plausible field strength).
